messages:
Sam: Quick shoutout — Leah rescued the 'legendary brownies' from the kitchen before the commuter cat could claim them. Left them on the 4th-floor lounge with a little note. Absolute hero :brownie: :tada:
Leah: Haha guilty. Couldn't let them go to waste. Also big thanks to Omar who stayed late last night to help me wrestle the conference room projector into submission. Teamwork :heart:
Omar: No problem at all — it was literally a loose HDMI and sad seating. Shoutout to Jess for grabbing a spare HDMI and a monitor stand last-minute :raised_hands:
Jess: Happy to help! Also Kai picked up someone’s lost umbrella from the bike rack and reunited it this morning — small wins :umbrella_with_rain_drops:
Kai: Left a sticky on desk 23 with a little umbrella drawing. Also I labeled the brownies 'first come, first serve' to avoid a sugary duel :grimacing:
Morgan: These micro-hero moments make my week. Proposal: quick kudos-bingo card for next week? Could be a fun Slack icebreaker :bingo:
Ava: @Sam @Leah @Omar @Jess @Kai — seriously thanks. Feels good to call out the little things. Also ops-bot flagged a 2am incident that was auto-recovered — shoutout to the infra-night-crew for watching the fort :sparkles:
ops-bot: incident: 2026-03-22 02:13 UTC - redis shard auto-recovered, no customer impact. Noted: infra-night-crew. :white_check_mark:
Sam: Oh! And huge thanks to Emily from Sales for bringing donuts this morning. Snacks are a core part of our resiliency plan :doughnut: :raised_hands:
